SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
CONFIDENTIAL
S.I. Special branch //8/abbb///
REPORT
File No...........
Date July 13, 19 39

Subject. Communication from the Italian Consulate-General dated June 29,
1939 concerning Miss Tamara K. Osipova.
Made by. D. S. Pavloff Forwarded by. C. Crawford. S.V.

Miss Tamara Kuzminichna OSIPOVA, Russian,
was born on April 28, 1916 at Blagoveschensk,
Siberia. She is reported to have left Russia
together with her mother in 1921 and to have
subsequently resided in Harbin. She arrived in
Shanghai from Harbin in 1929. From October 1933
to May 1935 she was employed as a shop assistant
with Baroukh's Haberdashery Store, 311-317
Kiangse Road. She left that place of employment
of her own accord and was unemployed until
December 1936 when she obtained the position
as a bar girl at Farren's Night Club, 325 Great
Western Road. In September 1937 she secured a
similar position at the Palace Hotel Bar, 3 Nanking
Road, and is still employed there.
In August, 1938 she was granted three
weeks leave which was spent in Hongkong. It was
on that occasion that she came into possession
of the Affidavit issued by the local H.B.M.
Consulate-General.
Miss Osipova at present resides at 118
Route des Soeurs, Apt. 14 Room 3.
There is nothing in the Municipal Police
records concerning her.

A. G. Pavloff -
D. S.

D.C.(Special Branch)

报告
档案号...........
日期 1939年7月13日

事由：意大利总领事馆1939年6月29日来函，关于塔玛拉·K·奥西波娃小姐（Miss Tamara K. Osipova）。
制作人：D. S. Pavloff 转呈人：C. Crawford. S.V.

塔玛拉·库兹米尼奇娜·奥西波娃（Tamara Kuzminichna OSIPOVA），俄罗斯人，
1916年4月28日出生于西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveschensk）。据报她于1921年
与其母一同离开俄国，随后居住于哈尔滨。她于1929年从哈尔滨抵达上海。1933年10月
至1935年5月期间，她在江西路311-317号巴鲁克百货店（Baroukh's Haberdashery Store）
担任店员。她自愿离职，此后一直失业，直至1936年12月在极司菲尔路（Great Western Road）
325号法伦夜总会（Farren's Night Club）获得酒吧女侍职位。1937年9月，她在南京路3号
华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）酒吧获得类似职位，并受雇至今。
1938年8月，她获准休假三周，期间前往香港。正是在那次行程中，她获得了由当地
英国驻华公使署总领事馆签发的宣誓书（Affidavit）。
奥西波娃小姐现居于姐妹路（Route des Soeurs）118号，14号公寓3室。
工部局警务处档案中并无关于她的记录。

A. G. Pavloff -
D. S.

副总监（特别处）

Acting Consul General for Italy,
SHANGHAI.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of
your letter No. 1272 dated June 29, 1939 and in reply
have to state that the matter is receiving attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sd. K. M. Bourne.
Commissioner of Police.

JHS.

No. 1272.
Pos. A. 53/I.

Shanghai, June 20th, 1939 (XVII).
7301
1 7 39

CONFIDENTIAL

Sir,

I should be grateful if you would kindly let
me have all possible information concerning Miss Tamara
K. Osipova, a Russian emigrant holding an Affidavit issued
by the British Consulate General in Shanghai on August 5th,
1939.

Thanking you in anticipation,
I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient Servant,

Acting Consul General for Italy.

The Commissioner of Police
Shanghai Municipal Council
